detail:
New decision "Contracts draft.3 (at merge): `superseded.by` becomes optional (a legacy superseded record with no pointer in either direction is carried as superseded, not disguised as overridden), and post `entry_type` re-admits the 1.x value "decision" for legacy records only (migration ingress; any other ingress still rejects it)" relates to:
- 01M2KKN9S1J74BYKJ475J607JH: "Capability at admission is evaluated against the membership projected from the event's CAUSAL ANCESTORS (the membership event must precede it in the parents graph), and rebuild() replays that same evaluation — never the replica's latest policy — so a policy added later can neither drop already-admitted events nor make admission order-dependent"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 1 existing decision(s) overlap
